selection: minimum fixed validation-pair softplus loss; same selector for every objective; tie earliest epoch
pair_contract: same user and fixed 30-minute exposure-time bin, distinct items; exclude within-bin contradictory-label items, collapse repeated consistent items to earliest event, one uniform observed nonclick per clicked item with replacement; only original fixed 1m training rows
scope: pseudo-contexts, not recovered requests or slates; unclicked is observed click=0, not intrinsic dislike; feedback arrival unknown; validation development only, never test labels
